comment: Tempo-synced beat repeat. Length selects a 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, or 1/4-note slice; BPM sets the grid. Mode selects continuous repeats, one repeat on effect activation, or one repeated slice every four beats. The 1/4 slice is capped at 32768 frames (~0.74s) by the stereo ring size.
fxid_comment: 0x01E5. Unused by existing effect manifests and tools/effects_db.json at implementation time.

params.name: Length
params.comment: Repeated slice length: 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, or 1/4 note; longest slice capped at 32768 frames (~0.74s).

params.name: BPM
params.comment: Tempo in BPM; DSP range is 40-240.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: 0-33 Continuous, 34-66 Manual, 67-100 Auto (one repeat every four beats). Manual mode triggers one slice when the effect is switched on.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Blend between live input and the repeated slice.
